text: Hello boys and girls, welcome to our English class.I'm Huang Dingyi.Nice to see you again.Boys and girls, in the previous lesson, we talked about our eating habits.Among them, some are good, others are bad.Today, we are going to make suggestions for eating habits.Before we start our lesson, please make sure that you have these things.Your student's book, your notebook, worksheet and pens.请准备好你的课本,笔记本,学习单和笔。Are you ready?Let's start.In the previous lesson, we know that Alice and Kitty are doing a quiz about eating habits together.Read the dialogue again and answer the question.What's wrong with Alice's eating habits?She doesn't drink much water every day, and she eats a lot of spicy food.These are the bad eating habits she has.I'm sure she would like to improve these bad eating habits.Please think about what Alice can do to improve her eating habits.Alice doesn't drink much water.It's a bad eating habit.She can drink a lot of water.Drinking a lot of water is important, because most of our body is water, and water makes our body work well.She eats a lot of spicy food.It's also a bad eating habit.She can eat a little spicy food.Eating too much spicy food is bad for our stomach.We sometimes tell people what they can do to make things better.That's what we call suggestions.Suggestion is a new word.It's a countable noun.It means 建议Read after me suggestionLet's think about ways of making suggestions.We usually use should to make suggestions.It means 应该Read after me shouldIn the previous lesson, we talked about eating habits in the aspects of diet and behavior.We can make suggestions for one's diet according to the food pyramid.When someone doesn't have the proper amount, as the food pyramid suggests, we can say,He or she should not have eat, drink too many or too much.We can also tell the proper amount he or she should have.We can say he or she should have a lot of, plenty of, some, a little, a few to indicate the proper amount.We can make suggestions for one's behavior by saying should do or should not do.Please give some suggestions to Alice.What should she do?Let's take a look at Max's answer.She should drink a lot of water every day.She should not eat too much spicy food.Well done!Shouldn't is the abbreviation of should not.We can use shouldn't for short.Look at the picture.Alice has another bad eating habit.Can you give a suggestion to her?This is Cindy's answer.She shouldn't exercise right after eating.She should wait at least half an hour.Great!They all used the modal verb should correctly and made reasonable suggestions.Max's suggestions are about diet.Cindy's are about behavior.We make suggestions for eating habits from these two aspects.Suppose you are Alice.Talk about suggestions for your own eating habits according to the Spidergram.Time's up.Let's take a look at Cindy's work.I'd like to improve my eating habits.For diet,I should have a lot of water every day.I shouldn't eat too much spicy food.I need to change my behavior too.I shouldn't exercise right after eating.I should wait at least half an hour.She talked about the suggestions for eating habits from two aspects.Good job!Kitty wants to see if Alice has really realized the problems.She asks Alice to give reasons for the suggestions.Think and answer the question.Why should you improve your eating habits?Max acted as Alice.Let's take a look at his answer.I should drink a lot of water because I need a lot of water every day.It keeps me healthy.Let's take a look at Cindy's answer.Eating a lot of spicy food is bad for my stomach.They both give proper reasons.Let's take a look at the pictures and make suggestions for Joe's eating habits.Let's check.Max gave Joe some suggestions.Let's read them.You shouldn't eat too much sweet food.Cindy's suggestions are a little different.You should eat less fried food.You should eat less sweet food.She used should do something instead of shouldn't do something.Bill also gave a different suggestion.You can eat some sweet food but only a little.Bill knows that Joe is a sweet food lover.So he made the suggestion by giving the proper amount.I'm sure you've also made some good suggestions.Joe doesn't know why he should improve his eating habits.Please think and answer Joe's question.Max gave reasons for suggestions 1 and 2.Let's read his reasons.Talking when you eat is bad for digestion.Watching TV when you eat is also bad for digestion.Cindy gave reasons for suggestions 3 and 4.Let's read her reasons.A lot of fat and sugar in the food you eat.You need only a little fat and sugar every day.Too much fried food and sweet food will make you fat.Let's sum up.Suggestions 1 and 2 are about behavior.When we talk about the suggestions about behavior,we can tell the reason such as doing something is bad for digestion.Or talk about the consequence like you may choke or get sick.Suggestions 3 and 4 are about diet.When we talk about the suggestions about diet,we can talk about the proper amount in the food pyramid.Or talk about the consequence like it's bad for your.Do you have bad eating habits?Let's make some suggestions for our own eating habits.We can make some suggestions with the help of the Spidergram.我們可以利用蜘蛛網狀圖你搞。Please complete the Spidergram and talk about suggestions for your own eating habits and the reasons.You can adjust your Spidergram if necessary.如有必要,你可以調整蜘蛛網狀圖。我們可以利用蜘蛛網狀圖。中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶You've learned how to use should and shouldn't to give suggestions.Besides, you've also learned how to write about suggestions for your eating habits.After class, please complete the exercises on your homework sheet.So much for today.See you next time.
